# N09 current-source retained-slot control

This procedure supplies the N09 row in the [current C1 lane](../../README.md).
The C# executable owns the real supervisor and worker. Python performs bounded
fixture staging, dispatch and detached retained-data checks.

## API and ordering

`execute(context, *, deadline)` requires the shared dispatcher's existing root
0700 output and five root 0600 inputs. It verifies the complete current capture,
actual Release CLI/runtime images and build logs before staging. It copies the
original projection parsers and fixed shell by captured hash, performs the real
same-host OS/ELF audit with its original empty helper root, and invokes the
original root utility wrapper. There is no peer-helper image or fabricated
historical build receipt.

The 900-second outer monotonic deadline includes all work. The literal native
shell retains its 600-second fixture clock, 30-second cleanup reserve, product
request budgets, retained-slot substitution, original C# cleanup, seven-line raw
projection and final path/NSS predicates. The provenance port replaces only the
retired packed build reader and historical source pin with the actual current
capture/build verifier, and adds the current sixth bootstrap environment entry.

`verify_retained_evidence(context, *, deadline)` starts no process. It reopens the
original `native-private.tar`, both actual command records and both stream files
per command, including zero-byte streams, then repeats the original N09 archive,
raw projection and cleanup predicates. A JSON envelope or reconstructed archive
is insufficient. The original archive has its separate 33,619,968-byte bound;
individual logs keep their 8 MiB bound.

The internal `validate_evidence` requires the actual capture, build and archive
bytes plus the original deadline. It checks data consistency only. No detached
data, portable test or successful staging call establishes a native owner,
admission, acceptance, catalogue entry or Trusted eligibility.

## Evidence limits

The historical-to-current shell diff is retained alongside the source. Original
parsers, dispatch and retainer bytes remain unchanged. The two portable controls
exercise current-source/base binding and raw observation/path guard data. Fresh
Linux N09 execution on the final source remains a prerequisite for a passing row.
